response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM counts) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM stats WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Trader types are grouped by trader.tradekind; only types with at least one qualifying analysis appear, so the average count and total are over those types (types with zero analyses are excluded).
Trader types with a NULL tradekind, if any, would form their own group and be included in the average and total.
